title: A reference page's line citations (contract reference-lines v1, 2.3)
description: Beside a page, in specs/reference/<path>.lines.json. For each symbol the page's statements cite: its file and lines at the graph's commit, or why there are none. Filled by code from the graph, never the AI, and read by no input hash (D118).

commit.description: The commit the graph was built from; null when nothing can be cited.

note.description: Why nothing on this page is cited: the graph has no commit, or doesn't say whether its tree was clean. A dirty file is answered per symbol.

why.description: Why this symbol has no lines.

note.description: What a reader must know about the lines given: a partial type's cover its first part only.
